title: feat: expose form workflow via get_form_instructions tool
body:
## Summary
- Applications no longer have to repeat the form-fill workflow in their own system prompts — the controller carries its own contract, so adopters only supply domain context.
- Mirrors the existing `get_chart_instructions` / `get_grid_instructions` pattern so behaviour is consistent across AI-component controllers.

Fixes https://github.com/orgs/vaadin/projects/103/views/3?pane=issue&itemId=189954324
